what_it_predicts: The date each open order line is invoiced, with an earliest and latest date.
tested_on: 190 order lines closed in July and August 2026, predicted as if from 1 July without knowing the outcome.
strongest_signal: If the lot has started on its line, median 5 days to invoice. If not, median 19 days.
known_gaps: The plan file has no reason column, so a line change or priority jump cannot be explained from data.
Promised dates are missing on about 1 order in 8; the practice of entering them lapsed in 2025.
Packing is entered 2 to 3 days after production.
status: Not yet good enough to print on a customer confirmation. Aditya's target is an average miss of 4 days.
